permissionModes.label: Ask before edits
permissionModes.description: Asks before editing files and running commands.

permissionModes.label: Accept edits
permissionModes.description: Edits files without asking; asks before running commands.

permissionModes.label: Plan
permissionModes.description: Explores and plans without changing anything.

permissionModes.label: Auto
permissionModes.description: A classifier approves safe actions; risky ones still ask.

permissionModes.label: Don't ask
permissionModes.description: Never asks; anything not allowed beforehand is refused.

permissionModes.label: Bypass permissions
permissionModes.description: Runs everything without asking. Like a remote terminal.
